map.计算通胀对购买力的影响，支持正向/反向计算: Compute inflation's impact on purchasing power, with forward/reverse calculation
map.现在的钱未来值多少: What today's money is worth in the future
map.未来的钱现在值多少: What future money is worth today
map.未来价格 = 现值 × (1 + 通胀率)^年数；保值所需现值 = 未来金额 /: Future price = present value × (1 + inflation rate)^years; present value to preserve value = future amount / (1 + inflation rate)^years
map.基于复利模型刻画货币购买力变化：正向求未来同等商品的名义价格，反向求维持购买力所: Using a compound model to depict changes in money's purchasing power: forward to find the future nominal price of the same goods, reverse to find the current amount needed to preserve purchasing power, for inflation-impact assessment and financial-goal setting.
map.算物价上涨后货币购买力缩水: Compute the erosion of purchasing power after price rises
map.把历史金额折算成今天等价: Convert a historical amount into today's equivalent
map.定长期目标的实际收益: Set the real return of long-term goals
map.年通胀 3%，今天 100 元的购买力 10 年后 ≈ 100/(1.03^10: At 3% annual inflation, the purchasing power of 100 yuan today ≈ 100/(1.03^10) ≈ 74 yuan in 10 years; money 'thins out', and nominal growth must exceed inflation to truly gain.
map.20 年前 1 万按累计通胀折算成今天等价购买力，需用各年 CPI 连乘，而非单: Converting 10k from 20 years ago to today's equivalent purchasing power needs the yearly CPI multiplied together, not a single-year rate; the tool compounds it.
map.实际利率怎么算？: How is the real interest rate calculated?
map.实际利率 ≈ 名义利率 - 通胀率（精确为 (1+名义)/(1+通胀)-1）。通: Real rate ≈ nominal rate − inflation (precisely (1+nominal)/(1+inflation)−1). When inflation is high, even with nominal interest, the real rate can be near 0 or even negative.
map.它侵蚀现金购买力，影响储蓄、工资、定价的真实价值；做长期财务规划必须扣除通胀看「: It erodes cash purchasing power and affects the real value of savings, wages and pricing; long-term financial planning must subtract inflation to see 'real' growth.
map.通货膨胀计算器。输入当前金额、年通胀率与年限，工具正向计算未来同等商品的名义价格: Inflation Calculator. Enter the current amount, annual inflation rate and years; the tool forward-computes the future nominal price of the same goods, or reverse-computes how much to reserve now to preserve value.
